items.title: Reddit’s (RDDT) Short-Term Pains May Lead to Long-Term Gains
items.summary: Reddit’s (RDDT) short-term pains may lead to long-term gains, in my view. This crash followed traffic headwinds from Google’s (GOOGL) AI Overviews and the rollout of its new artificial intelligence (AI) Mode features, which negatively impacted Reddit’s user growth.
